scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @findit/web" "npm run dev -w @findit/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @findit/api && npm run build -w @findit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @findit/web && npm run lint -w @findit/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @findit/web && npm run typecheck -w @findit/api
